system.description:
1 Armour Slot. Lifesaver: if a Strike would take your Lifeline to 0 Health Points while it is equipped, the helmet is permanently destroyed instead and you are left at 1 Health Point. Torchlight: lights the area in front of you out to Medium Range.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.154
